title: That Gravel Under Train Tracks Isn't Landscaping
hook: Loose stones doing four structural jobs at once.

cast.note: Bill trackside. Four jobs, four marks — this episode is a list done visually.

scenes.from: Train tracks sit on a bed
scenes.note: Establish the stones as deliberate, not mess. The angularity matters later — show it now.

beats.action: a track bed in profile; sharp stones packed under the sleepers
camera punches into the stones; their sharp edges draw clearly
an ON PURPOSE label lands; four empty tally marks appear
the camera tracks along the sleepers, stones packed between them
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: Job one. A narrow load spreading into a wide cone is the clearest possible drawing of it.

beats.action: a loaded train presses down on a single rail in cross-section
a heavy arrow drives down through rail and sleeper
the force fans out through the stones into a wide cone
a no-ballast version beside it punches straight into the ground; first tally fills
the force cone widens further down into the bed
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: Job two. Angular versus rounded, side by side. The rounded bed should visibly flow apart.

beats.action: angular stones and round pebbles fill two panels
the angular stones wedge against each other and hold
the rounded panel rolls apart under a sideways push; second tally fills
the angular stones settle another notch against each other
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: Job three. Water falling straight through, versus a mud bed. Quick.

beats.action: rain falls onto the ballast bed
water runs through the gaps and away beneath
a sealed bed beside it turns to mud and sags; third tally fills

scenes.note: Job four. Vibration damped between stones. Fourth tally completes the set — that is the button.

beats.action: a train passes; vibration rings radiate down into the bed
the rings scatter and fade between the stones
Bill barely rocks trackside; the fourth tally fills and all four glow; hard cut
